'''Nunkee''' was a fish spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who lulled fishers to sleep and ate their bait. "Nunkee" was a popular name given to female Ewoks.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nunkee was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
